assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / registered layer for web animation. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an approved weekly-cashback-v4-rooster.png 1882x836 promotional banner. This is precise layer separation, not a redesign. The output MUST retain the entire 1882x836 canvas and exact original pixel registration; do not recenter, resize, zoom or shift anything. Preserve original art, letter shapes, colors, textures and silhouette. Create the BACKGROUND CLEAN PLATE ONLY. Remove the ENTIRE thumbs-up rooster including face, comb, tail, jacket, hands, legs and every gold edge or shadow. Also remove ALL foreground campaign copy, numerals, peso/percent signs, dark outlines and colored offset shadows: WEEKLY on the first line, CASHBACK on the second, and huge 10% below. Pink offset paint shadow on the amount. Reconstruct all removed regions as a continuous believable extension of the existing weathered graffiti concrete wall, keeping the original pink/cyan/mint/navy color palette for this specific input, dark painted left text area, seams, abstract paint swipes and drips. Abstract graffiti is okay; NO readable letters, no number ghosts, no mascot remnants, no promotional copy, no humans, no new objects. An opaque full-canvas backdrop that can sit beneath separate transparent text and mascot sprites. Keep all unoccluded background detail in place.

Leave all blank transparent space on the left so the sprite remains registered to the original banner.

motion.slogan: Slide in from the left over 750ms; qualifiers staggered.
motion.rooster: Weekly slides from right, Payday leaps upward, First 3 Deposits slides forward from right.
motion.amount: Scale from 35% to 108%, rebound to 98.5%, settle at 100% over 1050ms.
motion.start: On first visible intersection after all layers load; carousel remount and Design replay restart.
motion.fallback: Original static banner for image mode, reduced motion, or load failure.
